gaps.explanation: Statement (Exhibit H, p8) total operating disbursements/depreciation 404,952 + interest/fees expense 47,017 = 451,969 includes Depreciation 239,087. The only schedule (Schedule 5, p14) prints Proprietary Funds disbursements 494,387 on the budgetary cash basis = payments to employees 54,576 + payments for supplies & services 111,289 + purchase of capital assets 131,505 + payment of long-term liabilities 150,000 + interest/fees 47,017 (Exhibit I, p9) = 494,387. 451,969 - 239,087 + 131,505 + 150,000 = 494,387 (gap -42,418 = 239,087 depreciation not on cash basis minus 281,505 capital purchases and debt principal not on the statement). Both printed totals are correct; no detail change.
